text:
maya: Heads up — infra patch pushed, milestone drift incoming. We should decide a trimmed launch approach by EOD. Options: slice-first (deliver core UX across tiers) or straight-cut MVP. @sam @jordi :eyes:

sam: Current infra delay looks like ~2 weeks if we don't re-scope. Slice-first reduces immediate customer impact IMO.

jordi: SRE note — slice-first increases rollout surface area. Need a strict fallback + canary region.

priya: From customer signals: top asks = latency visibility per model, token-cost dashboard, model pinning. Can we push model pinning to v1 and keep the other two in MVP?

leo: Design: if model pinning goes to v1 we should hide the control in MVP, not show a broken btn. I can whip up a placeholder.

maya: Proposed cutlist for MVP:
- keep: latency visibility, token-cost dashboard, error alerts
- defer to v1: model pinning, full RBAC audit UI, advanced batching config
Anyone blocking? :thinking_face:

sam: Not blocking from eng. Need to confirm batching config removal doesn't break existing autoscale heuristics.

jordi: If we cut pinning, update runbooks and support playbooks ASAP. Also need a canary rollback play: `canary->wait->promote/rollback`.

priya: Proposed launch gates for MVP (quick):
```
- e2e P95 latency <= 300ms across hosted tier
- embeddings throughput >= 200 req/s on dedicated pool (synthetic load)
- 2 pilot customers signed and smoke tests green
```

maya: Action items:
- @sam validate P95 by Thu EOD (load test results in PR)
- @jordi update runbook + canary plan
- @leo add placeholder UI in staging
- @priya update roadmap doc and draft customer comms

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> us-east-1 at 2024-08-01T09:00Z :rocket:

sam: Will run load tests tonight and post summary here.

maya: Thanks team — sync tomorrow 9am PT to lock the cut. :calendar:
